cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(DRRecomp C CXX)
if (APPLE)
    # plume (plume_apple.mm) and SDL have Objective-C sources: the languages must be enabled at the
    # top level, or generation fails (CMAKE_OBJC_COMPILE_OBJECT not set).
    enable_language(OBJC OBJCXX)
endif()

# Dead Rising static recompilation runtime.
# Layout:  ../ppc            generated by XenonRecomp (config/DR.toml)
#          ../tools/XenonRecomp  XenonUtils (XEX loading) + thirdparty
#          src/              runtime (kernel layer based on UnleashedRecomp, GPL-3.0)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if (NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Build with clang / clang-cl: the generated code relies on Clang extensions.")
endif()

set(DR_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..")
set(XENON_ROOT "${DR_ROOT}/tools/XenonRecomp")
set(XENON_THIRDPARTY "${XENON_ROOT}/thirdparty")

# Same code generation settings UnleashedRecomp uses for recompiled code.
add_compile_options(-fno-strict-aliasing)
if (MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/fp:strict)
else()
    add_compile_options(-ffp-model=strict)
endif()
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "AMD64|x86_64")
    add_compile_options(-march=sandybridge)
endif()

add_compile_definitions(NOMINMAX FMT_HEADER_ONLY _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)

# ---- Recompiled game code ------------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB DR_PPC_SOURCES "${DR_ROOT}/ppc/*.cpp")
add_library(DRRecompLib STATIC ${DR_PPC_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(DRRecompLib PUBLIC "${DR_ROOT}" "${DR_ROOT}/ppc" "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/simde")
target_compile_options(DRRecompLib PRIVATE -Wno-unused-label -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-asm-operand-widths)
# src/ppc_detail/ppc_detail.h: MMIO stores (XMA kick/lock/clear) also reach the runtime.
target_include_directories(DRRecompLib PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ppc_detail")
target_compile_definitions(DRRecompLib PRIVATE PPC_INCLUDE_DETAIL)

# ---- XenonUtils (XEX decryption/decompression) ---------------------------------------------
add_library(DRXenonUtils STATIC
    "${XENON_ROOT}/XenonUtils/xex.cpp"
    "${XENON_ROOT}/XenonUtils/image.cpp"
    "${XENON_ROOT}/XenonUtils/xex_patcher.cpp"
    "${XENON_ROOT}/XenonUtils/memory_mapped_file.cpp"
    "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/libmspack/libmspack/mspack/lzxd.c"
    "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/tiny-AES-c/aes.c"
)
target_include_directories(DRXenonUtils
    PUBLIC  "${XENON_ROOT}/XenonUtils" "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/simde"
    PRIVATE "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/libmspack/libmspack/mspack" "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/tiny-AES-c" "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/TinySHA1"
)

# ---- Small libraries -----------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(DRThirdParty STATIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/thirdparty/o1heap/o1heap.c"
    "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/xxHash/xxhash.c"
)
target_include_directories(DRThirdParty PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/thirdparty/o1heap"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/thirdparty/unordered_dense/include"
    "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/xxHash"
    "${XENON_THIRDPARTY}/fmt/include"
)

# ---- Window + GPU: SDL2 (static) and plume (D3D12 / Vulkan / Metal) -------------------------
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL2_DISABLE_SDL2MAIN ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(thirdparty/SDL EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory("${DR_ROOT}/tools/plume" plume EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# ---- Translated shaders (docs/shaders.md) ----------------------------------------------------
# Generated by xfb2xenos + XenosRecomp (scripts/build_shaders.bat).
set(XENOS_THIRDPARTY "${DR_ROOT}/tools/XenosRecomp/thirdparty")
set(DR_SHADER_CACHE "${DR_ROOT}/analysis/shader_cache/shader_cache.cpp" CACHE FILEPATH "XenosRecomp shader cache")
set(DR_SHADER_KEYS "${DR_ROOT}/analysis/shaders_2008/shader_keys.cpp" CACHE FILEPATH "xfb2xenos shader key table")
add_library(DRShaderCache STATIC "${DR_SHADER_CACHE}" "${DR_SHADER_KEYS}")
target_include_directories(DRShaderCache PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/gpu")

# zstd (decompression only) for the cache, smol-v for its SPIR-V.
set(ZSTD_LIB "${XENOS_THIRDPARTY}/zstd/lib")
add_library(DRZstd STATIC
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/debug.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/entropy_common.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/error_private.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/fse_decompress.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/pool.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/threading.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/xxhash.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/common/zstd_common.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/decompress/huf_decompress.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/decompress/zstd_ddict.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/decompress/zstd_decompress.c"
    "${ZSTD_LIB}/decompress/zstd_decompress_block.c"
)
target_include_directories(DRZstd PUBLIC "${ZSTD_LIB}")
target_compile_definitions(DRZstd PRIVATE ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM=1)

add_library(DRSmolv STATIC "${XENOS_THIRDPARTY}/smol-v/source/smolv.cpp")
target_include_directories(DRSmolv PUBLIC "${XENOS_THIRDPARTY}/smol-v/source")

# ---- Runtime --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(DR_RUNTIME_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/cpu/guest_thread.cpp
    src/kernel/heap.cpp
    src/kernel/memory.cpp
    src/kernel/xdm.cpp
    src/kernel/xam.cpp
    src/kernel/imports.cpp
    src/kernel/imports_dr.cpp
    src/kernel/virtual_memory.cpp
    src/kernel/io/file_system_dr.cpp
    src/gpu/command_processor.cpp
    src/gpu/video.cpp
    src/gpu/d3d_hooks.cpp
    src/patches/enemy_trace.cpp
    src/gpu/shaders.cpp
    src/gpu/renderer.cpp
    src/gpu/texture_decode.cpp
    src/hid/input.cpp
    src/hid/touch_controls.cpp
    src/apu/audio.cpp
    src/apu/xma.cpp
    src/patches/frame_rate_hooks.cpp
    src/user/config.cpp
    src/ui/options_menu.cpp
    src/profiler/cpu_sampler.cpp
    src/os/hang_watchdog.cpp
)
list(APPEND DR_RUNTIME_SOURCES src/os/logger_win32.cpp) # stdio: portable despite the name

add_executable(DRRecomp ${DR_RUNTIME_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(DRRecomp PRIVATE src)
target_precompile_headers(DRRecomp PRIVATE src/stdafx.h)
target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE DRRecompLib DRXenonUtils DRThirdParty SDL2::SDL2-static plume
    DRShaderCache DRZstd DRSmolv)
target_compile_definitions(DRRecomp PRIVATE SDL_MAIN_HANDLED)
target_compile_options(DRRecomp PRIVATE -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function -Wno-asm-operand-widths)

# XMA audio (apu/xma.cpp) uses FFmpeg's XMA2 decoder: DR_FFMPEG_DIR points at an FFmpeg build
# (include/, lib/ with libavcodec and libavutil). Without it the game runs silent.
set(DR_FFMPEG_DIR "" CACHE PATH "FFmpeg build with the XMA2 decoder (include/, lib/)")
if (DR_FFMPEG_DIR)
    # NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH: cross-compiling for iOS, CMake would look for the path inside the SDK.
    find_library(DR_AVCODEC NAMES avcodec libavcodec PATHS "${DR_FFMPEG_DIR}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH REQUIRED)
    find_library(DR_AVUTIL NAMES avutil libavutil PATHS "${DR_FFMPEG_DIR}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH REQUIRED)
    target_include_directories(DRRecomp PRIVATE "${DR_FFMPEG_DIR}/include")
    target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE ${DR_AVCODEC} ${DR_AVUTIL})
    if (WIN32)
        target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE bcrypt ole32 user32)
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(DRRecomp PRIVATE DR_HAVE_FFMPEG)
endif()

if (WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE winmm d3d12 dxgi dxguid)
    # DXC links the pixel shaders' DXIL libraries with their specialization constants at runtime
    # (as UnleashedRecomp); dxil.dll signs the result.
    set(DXC_BIN "${XENOS_THIRDPARTY}/dxc-bin")
    target_include_directories(DRRecomp PRIVATE "${DXC_BIN}/inc")
    target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE "${DXC_BIN}/lib/x64/dxcompiler.lib")
    add_custom_command(TARGET DRRecomp POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${DXC_BIN}/bin/x64/dxcompiler.dll" "${DXC_BIN}/bin/x64/dxil.dll"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:DRRecomp>")
    # The recompiled code needs a big stack for deep guest call chains.
    target_link_options(DRRecomp PRIVATE /STACK:16777216)
endif()

# ---- iPhone / iPad (docs/ios.md): an app bundle, Vulkan through MoltenVK ------------------------
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS")
    set(DR_IOS_BUNDLE_ID "com.debeanz.deadrising" CACHE STRING "iOS bundle identifier")
    set(DR_MOLTENVK_FRAMEWORK "" CACHE PATH "MoltenVK.framework (dynamic, ios-arm64) embedded in the app")
    set_target_properties(DRRecomp PROPERTIES
        MACOSX_BUNDLE TRUE
        OUTPUT_NAME "DeadRising"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ios/Info.plist.in"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "${DR_IOS_BUNDLE_ID}"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "Dead Rising"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING "0.1"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION "1")
    target_link_options(DRRecomp PRIVATE "-Wl,-rpath,@executable_path/Frameworks")
    find_library(DR_GAMECONTROLLER GameController REQUIRED)
    find_library(DR_COREHAPTICS CoreHaptics REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE ${DR_GAMECONTROLLER} ${DR_COREHAPTICS})

    # The start screen (ios/Launcher.swift, SwiftUI): compiled to an object with swiftc, as the Tunic port
    # does, and called from src/os/ios_launcher.mm through the Objective-C runtime.
    execute_process(COMMAND xcrun -f swiftc OUTPUT_VARIABLE DR_SWIFTC OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
    execute_process(COMMAND xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path OUTPUT_VARIABLE DR_IOS_SDK OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
    get_filename_component(DR_SWIFT_BIN "${DR_SWIFTC}" DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(DR_SWIFT_USR "${DR_SWIFT_BIN}" DIRECTORY)
    set(DR_LAUNCHER_OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Launcher.o")
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${DR_LAUNCHER_OBJECT}"
        COMMAND "${DR_SWIFTC}" -target "arm64-apple-ios${CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}" -sdk "${DR_IOS_SDK}" -O -parse-as-library
            -emit-object -module-name DRLauncherUI -wmo "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ios/Launcher.swift" -o "${DR_LAUNCHER_OBJECT}"
        DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ios/Launcher.swift"
        COMMENT "Swift: the start screen")
    set_source_files_properties("${DR_LAUNCHER_OBJECT}" PROPERTIES EXTERNAL_OBJECT TRUE GENERATED TRUE)
    target_sources(DRRecomp PRIVATE "${DR_LAUNCHER_OBJECT}" src/os/ios_launcher.mm src/os/ios_overlay.mm)
    # Everything that is not the game, in UIKit (src/os/ios_overlay.mm): the controls, Settings, the live log.
    set_source_files_properties(src/os/ios_launcher.mm src/os/ios_overlay.mm PROPERTIES SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS ON COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fobjc-arc")
    target_link_options(DRRecomp PRIVATE "-L${DR_IOS_SDK}/usr/lib/swift" "-L${DR_SWIFT_USR}/lib/swift/iphoneos" "-Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/swift")
    find_library(DR_UIKIT UIKit REQUIRED)
    find_library(DR_SWIFTUI SwiftUI REQUIRED)
    find_library(DR_QUARTZCORE QuartzCore REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(DRRecomp PRIVATE ${DR_UIKIT} ${DR_SWIFTUI} ${DR_QUARTZCORE})
    if (DR_MOLTENVK_FRAMEWORK)
        add_custom_command(TARGET DRRecomp POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_DIR:DRRecomp>/Frameworks"
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${DR_MOLTENVK_FRAMEWORK}" "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_DIR:DRRecomp>/Frameworks/MoltenVK.framework")
    else()
        message(WARNING "DR_MOLTENVK_FRAMEWORK is not set: the app will not find Vulkan on the device.")
    endif()
endif()

# ---- Diagnostic: per-function call profiler (maps Dead Rising's Direct3D) -------------------
option(DR_CALL_PROFILER "Wrap every recompiled function with a call counter" OFF)
if (DR_CALL_PROFILER)
    target_sources(DRRecomp PRIVATE src/profiler/call_profiler.cpp src/profiler/call_profiler_gen.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(DRRecomp PRIVATE DR_CALL_PROFILER)
    set_source_files_properties(src/profiler/call_profiler_gen.cpp PROPERTIES SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS ON)
endif()
